payload.note: Complete-g4 lower-loop checkpoint: exhaustive exact affine enumeration gives ten zero-loop and twenty-seven surviving one-loop rows for every L>=7; the source maximum six corrects the earlier scratch L>=5 scope. The zero-loop rows combine exactly to L^-4 Z(omega_p) with positive limit 111/(32*pi^4). Selectable cubic and all-leg quartic/quintic bounds, the exact K3(-2p,p,p)=-(2/3)cos^2(p/2)omega_p^3 identity, and a five-centre torus shell lemma prove the complete one-loop sector is O(log L). Both lower-loop sectors are o(N omega_p), so the complete perturbative M4 coefficient inherits the certified strictly negative two-loop leading coefficient c4+c7. This does not establish uniformity of the tuned perturbative series, the nonperturbative score, or the actual interacting H^-1 moment. The next gate is a nonperturbative centered conditional-score/convexity or shell estimate with a uniform remainder.
